_note: Final thesis item F4.5 - electrics, safety and communication of all F4 conveyors and stations. DESIGN values / REFERENCE ESTIMATES; catalogue classes 'or equal' [verify]. Tool: conv_elec.py. Guide: Doctor paper/61 chapters 49-60. Communication in two cases: A built-in PLC ports, B expansion modules (method of F3 Part D, asrs_comm.select_modules).

small_motor._: cos_phi, eta of small 4-pole motors (IE2 class allowed below 0.75 kW, EU 2019/1781) [verify]

drives._: per module type: [name, kW, area, how many per module]

io._: [DI, DO, F-DI, F-DO, AI] per element; drives are PROFINET devices (no DI/DO): 'pn' = PROFINET devices

PD_end._: stop up/down, 2 muting sensors; light curtain OSSD 2 ch; electric stop = PN drive; optical coupler 8/8 bit

check_TU1._: 2 runner sensors + portal door; 3 light grids (IO-Link/PN) + ID reader (PN); scale: Case A AI module, Case B Modbus RTU (F3 Part D)

flow_lane._: entry free + crate at exit; separator actuator

flow_block._: one AGV coupler + light curtain per department block

spur._: transfer up/down/in/out, spur track 2 positions, stopper DO + feedback

lift_table._: up/down limit + pit cover, 3 valves, safety edge 2 ch, height sensor

dock_tu._: AGV dock at TU1 / TU2 / TU3 of the AS/RS front: 2 muting sensors, light curtain 2 ch, optical coupler

HMC.name: HMC pallet load station (cell controller of the HMC pallet system)

power_bus._: 400 V flat / hybrid power cable along the line with tap-offs to the decentralised drives

comm._: uses ../03_asrs/comm_data.json catalogue and asrs_comm.select_modules with these demands

PLC-CONV1.why_B: net 1 = west half of the spine, net 2 = east half (a cable fault stops only half of the stations); CP firewall for the factory link; RS-485 for the energy meters of the power-bus feeders

PLC-ASM1.why_B: net 1 = loop + spurs, net 2 = 7 test benches (vendor PLCs as PROFINET i-devices, separated so that a bench fault cannot stop the loop); CP firewall; RS-485 for the lift-table hydraulic units and energy meters

air._: [element, bore mm, stroke mm, double-acting, cycles per hour per element at the design rate]
